summary: The whole council declines to cross a picket line to attend the mayor's speech.
realLife: All eight Oakland council members skipped a state-of-the-city speech to honor a union's picket line; two joined the protesters outside.
sources: East Bay Express, Oakland council and picket line: https://eastbayexpress.com/?p=12348
inGame: the public-action engine (protest record: what it is over, who is in it, how many came: few, group or crowd) with officials at its edge; a body's members' presence record and a mayor's speech event

turns.summary: Some attend and some stay out.
No one respects the line and the speech goes ahead.
The mayor moves the speech to another place.
